name: Minds 1: crowding and the ideal free distribution
description: The richer patch's share of on-patch agents against the utility mind's crowding m (a site's welfare times (1 + n)^−m, n the agents next to it), at input ratios 2.10 and 4.42 (matching: 0.68 and 0.82), at vision 10–20 (both patches in sight). Sutherland 1983 predicts matching at m = 1 for patch-wide interference; this crowding is local. At vision 1–6 the knobs leave the share unchanged, since no agent can see both patches to weigh one against the other. Seeds 1–20, ticks 500–1000.
